2607.25680.title: Rashomon Alignment
2607.25680.paper_summary: We propose Rashomon Alignment (RA), a new measure to assess functional similarity between two models. Existing functional similarity measures are distributional, quantifying differences between outputs of models applied to real-world data. However, these measures can be regarded as ecologically valid only for regions in the input space represented by the available data. We introduce a geometrical perspective on functional model similarity, which estimates it across the entire data space, offering a comprehensive view of decision boundary alignment independent of any specific data distribution. We also propose geometric Rashomon Alignment as a measure of geometrical similarity, which is computed using data uniformly sampled from the instance space. We perform an experimental analysis on more than 90 datasets, examining critical cases where model alignment diverges from predictive accuracy. Our results show that geometrical and distributional alignment provide different and complementary perspectives on the similarity between models and algorithms. RA can be used for multiple purposes, including model selection, ensemble construction, and enhanced interpretability of machine learning models and algorithms.
2607.25680.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 Rashomon Alignment (RA)，這是一種評估兩個模型之間功能相似性的全新度量。現有的功能相似性度量是基於分佈的，量化應用於真實世界數據的模型輸出之間的差異。然後，這些度量僅在由可用數據表示的輸入空間的區域內被視為生態有效。我們引入了一種幾何視角來看待功能模型相似性，這種視角估算了整個數據空間的相似性，提供了一種獨立於任何特定數據分佈的決策邊界對齊的全面視野。我們還提出了幾何 Rashomon Alignment 作為幾何相似性的度量，這是使用從實例空間均勻採樣的數據計算得出的。我們對超過 90 個數據集進行了實驗分析，檢查模型對齊與預測準確性發散的關鍵情況。我們的結果顯示，幾何對齊和分佈對齊提供了不同且互補的模型和算法相似性視角。RA 可以用於多種目的，包括模型選擇、集成構建以及提高機器學習模型和算法的可解釋性。
